routing.reasoning: Complex workflow with multiple branching paths (payment/appeal), role-based permissions, parallel processing (notifications), and sub-workflows (appeal review process). Approval domain due to appeal submission and review workflow. SQL for relational data with complex relationships between tickets, users, payments, and appeals. Advanced forms needed for complex validation and conditional logic. Mobile-first required for field officers. Cross-platform for broad device support.
